hero.subtitle: AI agents for citizen services, sovereign data platforms and security aligned to national controls, delivered by one Saudi team.

context.title: The sector today
context.body: Government entities are moving services online, adopting AI and meeting Cloud First and data-protection expectations at the same time. Citizens expect fast, bilingual service on every channel, and data must stay under Saudi jurisdiction.

challenges.title: Service demand outpacing staff
challenges.body: Call centres and service counters struggle with peaks in demand.

challenges.title: Legacy systems and silos
challenges.body: Data spread across departments slows decisions and services.

challenges.title: Security and classification
challenges.body: Sensitive and classified data must be protected and traceable.

challenges.title: Local content and talent
challenges.body: Tenders increasingly reward local content and Saudi capability building.

useCases.title: Citizen service agents
useCases.body: Arabic AI agents that answer, track and complete service requests on WhatsApp and the web.

useCases.title: Classified document protection
useCases.body: Screen, file and print watermarks that make every copy traceable.

useCases.title: Executive dashboards
useCases.body: One trusted view of programme KPIs for leadership.

useCases.title: New headquarters infrastructure
useCases.body: Network, data room and meeting spaces delivered as one programme.

vision2030.body: Digital government is central to an effective, transparent and responsive public sector.
